question: Name the classical dancer who was awarded the ‘Sangeet Natak Akademi Award’ in 1966 for his contribution to Odissi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a great teacher and is still alive in the hearts of the people who pursue and admire the Indian Classical dance of Odisha.
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** is the proud winner of many precious awards. 
 
• He won **Padma Shri Award** in the year 1972 and the **Sangeet Natak Academy Award **in 1966. 
 
• In 1989, he became the proud winner of the **Padma Bhushan Award**. 
 
• He was honoured with the **Sangeet Academy Fellowship** in 1991. 
 
• Again, in the year 2000, he was awarded the highly remarkable **Padma Vibhushan Award.** 
 
• The government of Madhya Pradesh honoured him with the **Kalidas Samman** too.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nileshwar Mukherjee, Bipin Singh, and Haricharan Singh** were famous Manipuri dancer.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Academy recognizes eight – **Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Kathakali, Sattriya, Manipuri, and Mohiniyattam**. 
 
• 
 
 
 Sangeet Natak Akademi – India’s national academy of music, dance, and drama – is the first national academy of the arts set up by the Republic of India. It was created by a resolution of the (then) Ministry of Education, Government of India, dated** 31 May 1952**, which was notified in the Gazette of India of June** 1952**.
